subject: [PATCH v5 05/11] mm, swap: enable THP swapin for vswap entries

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch enables transparent huge page (THP) swapin for vswap entries, allowing large anonymous folios to be swapped in as a unit when their vswap entries share contiguous physical swap slots on a synchronous IO device. This change improves performance by reducing the number of faults and retries required during swap operations. The patch also introduces checks for zswap-backed or mixed-backing batches, which are still refused and fall back to order-0 faults. The approach taken involves modifying existing functions in the mm module to handle vswap entries and THP swapin.
